newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks end lower as rebound fizzles.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks end lower as rebound fizzles.

text.p: Wall Street stocks finished broadly lower on Wednesday, as profit-taking drained a three-session rebound of its steam.

The Dow industrials fell 45 points to close unofficially at 6564. The loss, which essentially wiped out a 53-point advance on Tuesday, was led by technology and financial stocks -- two groups that had paced the market's recent rally.
"Today we saw some giveback in the techs as well as the banks," said Scott Bleier, chief investment strategist at Prime Charter Ltd.
